tools.name: confirm_prescription
tools.description: Read back the current returned prescription and prices for customer review. This never confirms or creates a coupon.

tools.name: find_prescription_discount_prices
tools.description: For an explicit prescription discount-price request. Uses only customer-supplied medication, ZIP and exact quantity. Returns prices with the reusable session card; show its codes inline without extra confirmation.

tools.name: get_prescription_status
tools.description: Read current prescription or completed coupon status for this page session. Never starts pricing or coupon creation.

tools.name: open_prescription_lookup
tools.description: Navigation only: opens the existing ClixRx Advisor for a prescription discount-price lookup. This does not search, price, select a pharmacy, or create a coupon. After navigation, rediscover the Advisor page tools.

tools.name: refine_results
tools.description: Apply the customer's requested factual sort or filter to returned offers. Never select a pharmacy or create a coupon.

tools.name: refresh_stale_pricing
tools.description: Refresh current prescription prices and return the reusable session card. This may perform an idempotent card write.

tools.name: revise_prescription
tools.description: Replace the search with explicitly revised prescription details. Returns prices with the reusable session card; card issuance is an idempotent write.

tools.name: select_candidate
tools.description: Choose the exact returned medication option explicitly selected by the customer, then compare its prices and return the reusable session card. Never guess.

tools.name: select_pharmacy
tools.description: Selects an exact displayed pharmacy price for comparison. The reusable card is already returned with priced offers, so this selection does not issue another card. Legacy unresolved coupon recovery remains protected.
